title: Learning Distributions from Samples and Qualities
abstract: arXiv:2610.17956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study parameter estimation when each sample from a continuous parametric distribution is accompanied by a binary quality label governed by the same unknown parameter. By imposing hard feasibility constraints, deterministic labels can accelerate estimation from the classical $n^{-1/2}$ rate of smooth quality-aware M-estimators to $n^{-1}$. Combining PAC guarantees with local error-to-parameter conversions, we establish this rate for both identifiable and finitely ambiguous quality classifiers, with likelihood information resolving the latter ambiguity. When the quality model is known only up to an additive constant, we construct threshold-free pairwise preferences from oppositely labeled samples and retain the accelerated rate despite the unknown threshold. We further show that pointwise qualities and pairwise preferences are incomparable: either can be strictly more informative than the other. Our assumptions hold for Gaussian, Laplac

translated_title: 从样本与质量中学习分布
translated_abstract: 我们研究这样的参数估计问题：来自连续参数分布的每个样本都附带一个由同一未知参数控制的二元质量标签。通过施加硬可行性约束，确定性标签可以将估计速率从经典的光滑质量感知M-估计器的 $n^{-1/2}$ 加速到 $n^{-1}$。结合PAC保证与局部误差到参数的转换，我们对可识别的质量分类器和有限歧义的质量分类器都建立了这一速率，其中似然信息可以消除后者的歧义。当质量模型仅已知到一个加性常数时，我们从具有相反标签的样本中构造出无需阈值的成对偏好，并在阈值未知的情况下仍然保持加速速率。我们进一步表明，逐点质量与成对偏好之间是不可比的：任何一方都可能严格地比另一方更具信息量。我们的假设在高斯分布、拉普拉斯分布等情形下均成立。
tldr: 该论文证明，当分布样本附带由同一未知参数决定的二元质量标签时，硬可行性约束可将参数估计从经典 $n^{-1/2}$ 速率加速至 $n^{-1}$，即使在质量模型存在未知加性常数时（通过构造无需阈值的成对偏好）也能保持这一加速，并揭示了逐点质量与成对偏好在信息量上互不可比。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that binary quality labels governed by the same unknown parameter can accelerate distribution parameter estimation from the classical $n^{-1/2}$ rate to $n^{-1}$ via hard feasibility constraints, with the accelerated rate preserved even under unknown additive constants using threshold-free pairwise preferences, and shows that pointwise qualities and pairwise preferences are incomparable in informativeness.
